Cover — hero number, three result stats, monthly micro-columns. 2. Scorecard — hero revenue vs plan, monthly table. 3. Variance — actual vs plan columns per region, gap table. 4. Trend — five-region line chart, three findings. 5. Driver — product revenue by month, findings. 6. Portfolio — product table, margin observation. 7. Margin matrix — product × region margin heat table. 8. Commitments — three actions, concentration sidebar.
